ambiguities.impact: A standalone formalization faithful to the immediate proof context should at least cover lambda>0. The algebraic MGF identity and 1+x bound actually extend to all real lambda, but that broader domain is not explicitly claimed by the selected passage.

ambiguities.impact: An exact formal statement must encode a Bernoulli law or explicitly require the probability-valid parameter range; treating p_i as an arbitrary real would no longer represent the stated random variable.

contract_plain_english: Fix one of the Bernoulli coordinates X_i in the Chernoff proof. It is 1 with probability p_i and 0 with probability 1-p_i. Therefore its uncentered moment-generating function at the proof's positive parameter lambda is exactly e^lambda p_i+(1-p_i), equivalently 1+(e^lambda-1)p_i. Applying 1+x<=exp(x) with x=(e^lambda-1)p_i bounds this by exp((e^lambda-1)p_i). This is a coordinatewise calculation; independence is not needed until the separate product step.
